description: This file contains hook implementations related to the Drupal Token system, including functions for providing token info, replacing tokens, and altering token data.

methods.name: hook_tokens
methods.description: Provides replacement values for placeholder tokens during token processing.

methods.name: hook_token_info
methods.description: Provides information about available token types and tokens.

methods.name: hook_token_info_alter
methods.description: Alters the metadata about available tokens and token types.

methods.name: hook_tokens_alter
methods.description: Modifies the replacement values for tokens after initial generation.
